description: Daily App Store impressions, page views, downloads and ratings for an iOS app, from App Store Connect

operations.description: Read-only. The app's App Store listing: the live version and the newest editable draft, each with per-locale name, subtitle, keywords, promotional text and description length (not the full description); the Custom Product Pages (id, name, visible); and the Product Page Optimization tests (name, state; experimentsAvailable=false when the account cannot read them). Takes no arguments. Output is capped near 7 KB: with many locales the primary one (en-US first) is kept and the rest dropped, with truncated=true and localesIncluded/localesTotal.

ingest.label: Daily App Store metrics
ingest.description: Impressions, page views, first-time downloads and redownloads per day, in total and per source type, plus the public rating, kept for the channel overview
